propositions: docs/releasing.md incorrectly describes the pypi environment required-reviewers rule as 'the second human approval' when it is actually approval by a single configured identity with self-review permitted
the current runbook tells operators to 'approve the pypi deployment when prompted' but approvals are routinely granted non-interactively via REST API, not through interactive UI prompts
.github/workflows/release.yml line 294 perpetuates the 'second human gate' framing in a comment, contradicting the corrected runbook
the approval mechanism guarantees identity and ref control over who can release the publish job but does not guarantee independent second-party review or human intervention

the runbook lacks a complete, runnable REST invocation for non-interactive approval including proper JSON typing of environment_ids as an integer array and the companion GET to discover the environment id
